_comment: BROKEN pattern — this is what the engineer currently has. Fails validation before any iteration runs.
why_it_fails: The platform validates the child workflow's inputSchema.required against EACH ELEMENT of data_array on its own — not against data_array + the static 'variables' block merged together. Each element here only has {subnet_name, subnet_cidr}; subscription_id and region live in the childJob task's static 'variables', which is a separate field the per-iteration validator does not consult. So every element is missing two required fields, and the platform fails workflow validation before the loop starts (this is a draft-workflow validation failure, not a per-iteration runtime error).
